verdict.rationale: Pipedream lets users write arbitrary Node.js/Python/Go code inside workflow steps, which can loop over arrays or call APIs repeatedly (pipedream-docs-10, pipedream-docs-24, pipedream-gh-1), and its REST/Connect APIs can manage many workflows or event sources programmatically (pipedream-docs-6, pipedream-docs-19). However, there is no documented dedicated bulk/batch action, for-each loop primitive, or explicit multi-item processing feature—only that custom code makes such logic possible. Missing for 10: a built-in batch/bulk-processing action or loop construct, explicit docs on iterating over large item sets, and independent confirmation of bulk throughput/performance.
